what: a sanity check: do uncorrected head motion or eddy-current proxies track the as-stated envelope gap (coverage - target at stated level) across pairs?
gap: coverage - target at stated 0.8, 0.9, 0.95 (negative: the envelope under-covers the rescan); 'mean' over the three. A negative rho: more motion or eddy, a larger shortfall

b0 motion: max edge mm.what: b0s onto the first, rigid: max over b0s of the max edge displacement

b0 motion: mean edge mm.what: b0s onto the first, rigid: mean over b0s of the mean edge displacement

DW rigid: p95 edge mm.what: DW volumes onto their prediction: rigid displacement at the edge, p95 over volumes

DW PE translation SD mm.what: SD over volumes of the PE translation

DW PE edge p95 mm.what: PE affine displacement at the edge, p95 over volumes

DW eddy (g-explained PE) RMS mm.what: the part of the PE edge displacement linear in the gradient direction, RMS over volumes

DW eddy R^2.what: share of the PE edge displacement's variance linear in g

proxy settings.mask: dipy median_otsu (radius 4, 4 passes) on the mean forward b0
proxy settings.prediction: log-linear least-squares tensor fit of the smoothed b0s and tracked shell
proxy settings.b0 registration: dipy AffineRegistration, rigid, MI (32 bins, sampling 0.5), levels 200/100/50, sigmas 2/1/0, factors 4/2/1, from the identity

caveats: correlation only, across pairs that differ in more than motion; small n (cohort II 4 per protocol: the smallest exact two-sided p is 0.083; cohort III 8 and 9; ON-Harmony 20)
many proxies x combinations x strata are tested: read single p-values below 0.05 with that multiplicity in mind

the proxies are not an eddy correction: the DW alignment is to a tensor prediction of the scan itself (the contrast for each direction, the scan's average position); contrast the tensor misses can be read as shifts, and on a half-sphere scheme part of it can be linear in g
the b0 motion is the b0s' only (cohort II's scanner A and B series have one forward b0: no b0 motion there); motion between b0s is not the motion of every DW volume
residual_left mixes motion between the b0 pair with field-model error and noise; cohort II's single-pair scans have one b0 each way
the swapped B2000 and site 3 pairs reuse B2000's scans (the same proxies, other roles): the pooled set without them is also given
the rescan's registration onto A (rigid, mode 3) and the resampling are not part of these proxies; a pair's registration quality (NCC) is listed per pair
